meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 GitHub 仓库中所有开放的 issue 和 PR，为每个项目单独生成一份包含证据链接的报告，并保存到 /tmp/ 文件夹。Claude 不会在 GitHub 上执行任何操作（如评论、关闭、合并等）。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs”或“github triage”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 所有开放的 issues。
say.note: Claude 会分析所有 issue 并生成报告。
Claude 会分析所有开放 PR。
Claude 会同时分析 issues 和 PRs。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze all open issues and PRs in the GitHub repository, generate evidence-backed reports for each item, and save them to /tmp/. Claude will not perform any actions on GitHub (no comments, closes, merges, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze all issues and generate reports.
Claude will analyze all open PRs.

say_en.text: Run a triage on the repository.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze both issues and PRs.
